paragraph: Two years ago, Rhys Wynne-Jones walked into St. Mary's Church in Penzance on a cold January night. He had been homeless for ten years. Someone recorded him playing the piano there. The video went viral. He raised fifty thousand dollars for charity. His whole life has turned around since then. A piano in a church on a winter night can change a room, and sometimes more.
